description: This PHP source file appears to be part of the TestLink open source test management system. It handles test case assignment execution, including assigning test cases to testers, removing assignments, bulk user removal, sending notification emails, and generating related views, all primarily for managing and executing test plans and test cases within the system.

classes.name: tree
classes.description: Represents a tree structure for test case organization or project hierarchy.

classes.name: testplan
classes.description: Handles operations related to test plans, including retrieving test plan info and associated features.

classes.name: testcase
classes.description: Handles test case data, including retrieving test case paths and details.

classes.name: assignment_mgr
classes.description: Manages test case assignments, including assigning, deleting, and retrieving status.

classes.name: tlPlatform
classes.description: Represents test project platforms and links them to test plans.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: Manages user data and retrieval for display and assignment purposes.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: A Smarty template wrapper for rendering views.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes request parameters into an arguments object for processing.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up GUI options and data structures based on test plan, project, and user info.

methods.name: send_mail_to_testers
methods.description: Builds and sends email notifications to testers about test case assignment changes.

methods.name: doRemoveAll
methods.description: Removes all selected test case assignments, optionally notifying testers.

methods.name: doBulkUserRemove
methods.description: Removes multiple users from assigned test cases, with email notification support.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Verifies if the current user has permission to perform assignment actions.
